## What the 10,000-user estimate rests on

No figure in this file is an actual operating cost: FlipFirst has no production bill yet. Inputs by kind:

| Input | Value | Kind | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Time per analysis | <= 60 ms | MEASURED | 50,000 SIMULATED listings, SQLite and PostgreSQL |
| Size of a saved analysis | 10.7 KB | MEASURED | same run |
| Analyses per user per month | 15 | ASSUMED | pilot_report will measure |
| Saved deals per user | 10 | ASSUMED |  |
| Emails per user per month | 3 | ASSUMED |  |
| Push alerts per user per month | 30 | ASSUMED | ntfy.sh, $0 |
| Users per polled territory; polling interval | 150; every 30 min | ASSUMED | model.py base case |
| Server sizing per scale | 1 small VPS up to 100 users ... 3 servers + database standby at 10,000 | ASSUMED | not load-tested beyond 50,000 listings |
| Analyses that would need a licensed value | 60% | ASSUMED | tier 2 is not built |
| VPS (2 GB / 4 GB) | $12 / $24 a month | LIST PRICE | third-party summaries |
| Managed PostgreSQL (single / with standby) | $15 / $30 | LIST PRICE | model.py |
| Resend email | free to 3,000/mo, then $20 | LIST PRICE | third-party summary |
| Stripe | 2.9% + 30c + 0.7% Billing | LIST PRICE | third-party summary |
| MarketCheck Basic / Standard | $299 / $749 a month | LIST PRICE | official page, search excerpt |
| MarketCheck per call (private-party search / Price) | $0.01 / $0.07 | LIST PRICE | page excerpt / third-party |
| MarketCheck licence for FlipFirst's use | - | UNKNOWN | needs a written agreement and quote |
| eBay permission for price estimates | - | UNKNOWN | needs eBay's written answer |
| A free market-value source | - | UNKNOWN | none exists yet |
| Support time, legal review, owner time, refunds, taxes | - | NOT INCLUDED |  |

At 10,000 users, MarketCheck path ($1,843/mo):

| Component | Monthly | Share | Rests on |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Listing data (MarketCheck) | $1,714 | 93% | list prices + an UNKNOWN licence + ASSUMED territories and polling |
| Hosting and database | $102 | 6% | list prices × ASSUMED sizing |
| Email, backups, domain | $27.25 | 1% | list prices × ASSUMED volume |

The no-paid-data figure ($129/mo at 10,000 users) is **not a cost FlipFirst can run at today**. It leaves out data entirely, because no free licensed listing or value source exists yet: eBay's permission or a free value source is UNKNOWN. It also excludes support, legal and owner time.

Sensitivity at 10,000 users (MarketCheck path) to the data assumptions in model.py:

| Case | Users per territory | Poll every | Listing data | Total |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| optimistic | 250 | 30 min | $949 | $1,078 |
| base | 150 | 30 min | $1,714 | $1,843 |
| conservative | 100 | 15 min | $3,629 | $3,758 |

Optional licensed valuations (tier 2, not built) would add $6,300/mo at 15 analyses per user, and twice that at 30: usage drives that cost linearly. Analyze's own compute stays negligible either way (5.0 CPU-hours a month at 30 analyses per user).

An analysis against FlipFirst's own comparables costs nothing beyond hosting (measured 60 ms or less on 50,000 SIMULATED listings). An optional licensed valuation would cost $0.07 per call (MarketCheck Price Base, list price; not built, needs written permission), called for an estimated 60% of analyses.

Notes: a free pilot has no payment cost. "Free data" assumes eBay grants
price-estimate permission, or seller listings valued by a source that costs nothing —
neither exists yet. MarketCheck figures use list prices (Basic $299/mo, 5,000 calls;
Standard $749/mo) and a third-party ~$0.01 per call; get a quote.
